name: Summer: A VEEsual Novel
source: Project:SR's story follow Kazuki, a bullied boy, thinking of ending it all until Summer, a bright and lively girl, bumped into him. Our protagonist has suspicions about Summer's friendliness as she is seen as "too kind" or "too energetic", maybe it was a dare made by her friends. Will he finally find a reason to live for? Or will his suspicions be true?
